answer: Give every agent identity a reputation that fades unless renewed. At each epoch's dawn, an identity's weight halves unless it submits fresh, peer-graded work tied to that epoch's random seed. An honest agent pays this renewal once; a sybil farm must pay it for every puppet, every epoch, so costs scale linearly while each fake earns less. Graders treat a sudden plume of near-identical renewals as a beacon for a clustering audit, and flagged clusters lose their weight together.
